release_notes: Added selectable Window Capture mode for capturing any open application window.
Added real window-name selection and refresh controls.
Window Capture continues receiving the selected window when other windows are covering it.
Improved Window Capture latency with detection-ROI-only processing.
Separated preview processing from the detection pipeline.
Improved stale-frame handling using time-based freshness.
Includes previous v1.0.2 stability and runtime fixes.
